audit.whatIsWrong: The lane read credited Pantheon with an auto-attack block he no longer has.
audit.why: The page said "his passive blocks your early autos". Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will: "Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered." There is no auto block. A player spacing around a block that does not exist gives up free trades for nothing.
audit.corrected: early and whys[0] now describe Mortal Will as spell empowerment.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 stage was called even with no ultimate cooldown.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s — the longest ultimate in this whole slice. A spent Grand Starfall is a three-minute window, which is exactly why level 6 evens out rather than favouring him.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now carry the 180s, plus the 11s Comet Spear and 13s Shield Vault.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent from the entire page: Aegis Assault.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear" (22/21/20/19/18s). Dumping Q1-Q2-Q3 into the front of an Aegis Assault deals nothing. The answer is directional — get behind him, or wait out a 22-second cooldown — and the page never said so.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now says to attack it from behind or wait the 22s out.

edits.before: Pantheon owns Level 1-3 hard. His Q (Comet Spear) pokes you down for free, his W (Shield Vault) stun sets up an all-in, and his passive blocks your early autos — all while you have no Q pattern or E lifesteal to answer. This is a survive-and-farm phase: don't trade into his stun, respect that he can flat-out kill you if you step up, and give ground rather than feed. If he burns Q spears on the wave you get breathing room to CS. He's favoured because his early burst beats a comboless Aatrox.
edits.after: Pantheon owns level 1-3 hard. Comet Spear (Q) pokes you down on an 11s cooldown, Shield Vault (W) is a 13s dash-stun that sets up the all-in, and Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts — all while you have no Q pattern or E lifesteal. This is a survive-and-farm phase: don't trade into the stun, respect that he can flat-out kill you if you step up, and give ground rather than feed. If he burns spears on the wave you get breathing room to CS. He is favoured because his early burst beats a comboless Aatrox.

edits.before: Level 1 favours Pantheon as Comet Spear poke and his passive block beat a comboless Aatrox.
edits.after: Level 1 favours Pantheon as Comet Spear poke and Mortal Will empowerment beat a comboless Aatrox.

edits.before: His Grand Starfall gives roam and burst but doesn't help him kill you in lane by 6 — the trade evens out as your drain and R come online.
edits.after: Grand Starfall gives roam and burst but not lane kill threat by 6 — at 180s, a spent ult is a long safe window as your drain and R come online.

edits.before: Level 4 is still his — his Shield Vault stun and Comet Spear burst keep the edge until you stabilise. By Level 5 the lane levels out: you finally have your Q pattern and E drain, so you can heal back his poke and threaten a real trade if he mis-times Shield Vault. At 6, Grand Starfall gives him roam pressure but doesn't add lane kill threat against you, so play even and deny him a lead. Track his Q cooldown — when it's down, that's your window to step up and drain-trade. Don't overextend for a kill; just stabilize and reach your item spike.
edits.after: Level 4 is still his — Shield Vault's stun and Comet Spear burst keep the edge until you stabilise. By level 5 the lane levels out: with your Q pattern and E drain you heal back his poke and threaten a real trade if he mis-times the 13s Shield Vault. At 6, Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1 and adds roam pressure, not lane kill threat against you, so play even and deny him a lead. Track Comet Spear's 11s cooldown — when it is down, that is your window to step up and drain-trade. Don't overextend for a kill; stabilise and reach your item spike.

edits.before: Wait for your item spike to out-value his poke
edits.after: Hit Aegis Assault from behind or wait its 22s

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only); no grounding claim was made in this slice.
